pageDescription: Manage members, permissions, and settings. To switch or create another workspace, use the switcher at the top of the page.
createDescription: Create a separate environment for another brand, project, or client. It will start with its own free trial.
settingsDescription: Enter a custom name so you and other members can easily identify it
teamDescription: Manage this workspace's members and their permissions.
trialMembersTitle: Members are available after the trial
trialMembersDescription: During the free trial, only the owner can access the workspace. Subscribe to Postmade and configure more members to grow your team.
invitationSent: Invitation created. Copy the link to simulate email delivery.
limitReached: The member limit has been reached. Pending invitations also occupy a spot.
workspaceScopedNote: Members, invitations, and billing are exclusive to this workspace.
